body:
Replaces the foundation research-worker stub with `ssx-worker research`, using shared native configuration, policy/catalog resolution, 33 real adapter factories, HTTP/admission owners, and durable Valkey research/cache/snapshot stores. Configuration is captured once; equivalent effective configuration retains stable cache identity. Enabled adapters without a real factory fail preflight instead of silently disappearing. `--check-config` validates without store IO or readiness claims. Readiness follows actual runner startup; startup signals and shutdown drain the owned tasks.

Adds a complete 51-entry npm-only example and operator/portal-impact documentation. Workspace CI builds and supplies the actual worker and pinned Valkey, creates a private short fixture directory, then runs the unchanged workspace test command. Cleanup preserves a failing test exit and rejects leftover files. Only current-source metadata hashes and their owning gate literals are refreshed; historical captures and assertions remain unchanged.

Validation on the committed publication source:

- All 33 bounded local commands passed: workspace/all-target JSON build, strict Clippy, two exact ten-test lists, 20 individual composition tests, the full workspace test command with the real worker configuration, and F06/O01/A09/A10/A11/W06/F01/O06 gates.
- Actual compiler-selected worker/test images were archived. Every command preserved the complete 7,754-file source map and staged index. No retries, provider calls, backend Python oracle, or production activation ran.
- Pinned formatting, scoped contribution hooks, import-linter, and AST graph update passed. All-files hooks encountered the existing unrelated Ruff-format baseline; its edit was restored. A missing worktree-local lint environment link was supplied from the existing environment without installing tools.

This remains a bounded worker component. All 51 built-ins remain required: the remaining 18 are the five A12 engines, three A13 engines, CVE/NVD/EPSS/ExploitDB/MITRE ATT&CK, Google/DDG, and arXiv/OpenAlex/Semantic Scholar. Sentry configuration currently fails preflight; sender integration, suggestions/Jev/reranking/routing cache, distributed cooldown publication, complete configuration/health modes, parser ownership, F07 driver joins, other worker roles, and server/MCP/gateway/portal packaging remain open. The separate F07 ownership overlay is not included. No deployment is activated and neither W08 nor W09 is complete.

Fresh exact-head Linux AMD64/ARM64 Rust Foundation checks, required portal/general CI, and independent review remain required before merge. Earlier private component and causal receipts retain their original source identities; they are not relabeled as execution of this publication head.

Refs #914, #915. [Rust rewrite case study](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/main/docs/rust-rewrite/CASE_STUDY.md).
